title: Kim Kardashian Receives Strong Message From A Fan
htmlContent:
Earlier this month, Kanye West and Drake threw a benefit concert to bring awareness to "Free Larry Hoover." Ye switched the lyrics to his 2010 hit "Runaway," and referenced his ex-Kim Kardashian during that concert "I need you to run right back to me. More specifically, Kimberly" in the song's outro.

The crowd in attendance saw it as a direct plead to his ex-wife; according to dailytimes.com, she and her mother Kris Jenner and her boyfriend, Corey Gamble, were all in attendance.

However, according to a source that spoke with Page Six, Kardashian thinks it's weird that West is public pleading that he wants her back, but living with his new model girlfriend, Vinetria, in his Malibu home.

"Kim is making a statement by doubling down that she's single," a source told Page Six. "She thinks it's strange that Kanye keeps saying he wants her back, but all the while he's got the [22-year-old] model at his Malibu house."

On Sunday afternoon, DJ Akademiks posted a video of a fan telling Kim Kardashian that her ex is better at a movie theater.

"Yo, Kim, Kanye is way better I'm not even going to hold you."

It has been reported that Kim has been dating "Saturday Night Live" star Pete Davidson since November, and the couple made their first public appearance at West's Donda Academy's debut basketball game in Minneapolis on the 6th of November.

As for Kanye West, he bought nearly 4,000 toys in the south side of Chicago, according to ABC 7 Chicago.

"I'm so proud that Kanye is, once again, responding to our request to help the children of Englewood and beyond. He is no stranger to our community. His presence has always been felt in our neighborhoods and he loves visiting, but this Christmas he has truly been our modern-day Santa Claus," said Chicago Alderman Stephanie Coleman.
